## Automatic rule proposals

After choosing a device or integration, the options flow now proposes ready-made rules and preselects them: rule catalog (online, bundled copy offline), then a local analysis of standard Home Assistant metadata, then the manual list. Nothing is saved without confirmation; the catalog is validated as untrusted input; no polling or network access during monitoring. Details: `docs/AUTODETECT.md`.

- Bundled catalog entries for Synology DSM, UniFi, UniFi Network Plus, NUT, Raspberry Pi power/firmware, SMLIGHT, Home Assistant OS/add-on updates, ZHA, Z-Wave JS, Shelly, ESPHome and AVM FRITZ!Box.
- Known gaps: entities identifiable only by name (e.g. TouchKio error counter) need a manual rule.
- Backward compatibility with 0.1.5 was explicitly not required.

Aus der Einrichtung heraus werden Regeln jetzt automatisch vorgeschlagen und vorausgewählt; Details in `docs/AUTODETECT.md`.
